items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Then in the evening I heard Kit Homs Band was the first band I heard. I wasn't very impressed at all.

ctx.x: They were making a record that day?
Yeah, the next day they made the record. I wasn't there then. Oh, I see. Then in the evening I heard Kit Homs Band was the first band I heard. I wasn't very impressed at all.
